description: Generate a Solana keypair locally. Optionally grind for a base58 prefix/suffix (e.g. "three") and/or attach it to an avatar session. Returns the base58 pubkey and secret ONCE — store the secret yourself; the MCP does not persist it.

caseSensitive.description: Match case-sensitively (default true). Base58 has no 0OIl so set false to be permissive.

maxAttempts.description: Cap on grind attempts (default 500_000). Bump for longer prefixes.

sessionId.description: If set, the wallet is attached to this avatar session.

vanityPrefix.description: Base58 prefix to grind for (e.g. "three"). Up to 8 chars.

vanitySuffix.description: Base58 suffix to grind for. Up to 8 chars.

name: wallet_create
title: Create a Solana wallet (optionally vanity-grinded)
